recap: Cavaliers lost to the Bulls 132–123 in 2 overtimes.
Evan Mobley led the Cavaliers with 25 points (11-17 FG, 1-4 3PT), 13 rebounds and 1 assists.
DeMar DeRozan led the Bulls with 35 points (8-26 FG, 2-5 3PT), 10 rebounds and 5 assists.
CLE won 2 of 4 factors: shooting, ball security. Effective FG% 53.8 to 45.9.
Biggest swing: Donovan Mitchell misses 20-foot two point pullup jump shot (OT 1.5), −30 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): LeVert, Garland, Wade, Okoro, Mobley, +10 in 6:20.
Bench points: CLE 34, CHI 21. Points in the paint: 46–52. Second-chance points: 11–32.
